spontaneous.spontaneous_reading: The decisive move is to search over a spectral factor g rather than directly over trigonometric coefficients. Writing the candidate as a normalized squared modulus makes global non-negativity invariant under every parameter update, converting an infinite family of pointwise constraints into a built-in property.

Then b_0=1 and each b_k for k>0 is a scaled kth autocorrelation of the c-sequence, so P_K(x)>=0 for all x. Positive random initial c_k also give b_k>=0; the remaining condition b_1>b_0 is tested before annealing begins.

spontaneous.spontaneous_reading: The search uses two levels of objective fidelity. Improvements are accepted and worse moves are accepted with probability exp(-Delta R_2/T); temperatures and step sizes decrease. Searches over degrees 10 through 72 found a degree-46 polynomial with R_2=48.1587921551117. For the costlier all-height R_1 objective, searches were restricted, while a larger asymptotic search retained candidates for R_1 rescoring; a degree-40 candidate was then further annealed directly for R_1.

Four Heath-Brown families are denoted f^(i)_{eta,lambda,theta}, with the displayed scaling f^(i)_{eta,lambda,theta}(t)=eta h^(i)_{lambda,theta}(eta t).
